$comment: SBLA-004 candidate license inventory. Every licence field was read from the cited primary source on the cited date; none is recalled. Technical scores are deliberately null: master plan §18 assigns measurement to SBLA-005, and inventing a score here would defeat the spike gate.
scoringNote: Scores are 0-5. license_clarity below 4 rejects a candidate outright regardless of total, per master plan §8.3.

license.name: Varies by vendor
license.notes: No vendor selected. §8 forbids purchasing before the spike completes. §8.2 requires a written licence archive and a checksum of delivered files before this candidate can be scored.

candidates.name: Z-Anatomy

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
license.commercialUse: permitted for Z-Anatomy content; NOT permitted for two bundled reference models
license.attributionString: "BodyParts3D" - The Database Center for Life Science - CC-BY 4.0; "Z-Anatomy" - CC-BY-SA 4.0
license.aiProcessingPermitted: not restricted by the licence text
license.shareAlikeQuote: ShareAlike: Derivative works must be shared under CC-BY-SA 4.0.
license.notes: The cited GitHub LICENSE file licenses the APP and on its second line defers model licensing to a separate document. That document states all Z-Anatomy content is CC-BY-SA 4.0 including commercial use, but its ATTRIBUTIONS/HUMAN MODEL section lists reference models under CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0 (inner ear) and CC-BY-NC 4.0 (kidney). Whether those NonCommercial models ship as geometry or were used only as modelling reference is NOT established. The earlier BodyParts3D attribution disagreement is resolved because DBCLS's current license page now also states CC BY 4.0. The share-alike boundary between the Z-Anatomy asset package and the application remains open per master plan 8.2.
license.topLevelQuote: All the code and content shared by 'Z-Anatomy' is under CC-BY-SA 4.0 license. You are free to: Share, adapt, and redistribute the material for any purpose, even commercially.

componentLicences.component: Cranial Nerves and Foramina (University of Dundee, CAHID)
Anatomy of the Inner Ear (University of Dundee School of Medicine)

scoreRationale.license_clarity: 3, below the 8.3 floor. Revised down from an earlier 4 after following the referral the LICENSE file gives on its own second line: the picture is mixed, not blanket CC BY-SA 4.0.

candidates.ineligibleReason: Mixed licensing: two NonCommercial reference models are listed inside the human model and their redistribution status is unestablished. Ineligible under master plan 8.3 until the component boundary is resolved.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.shareAlike: not required by the current license page; the acquired OBJ retains a historical CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan header
license.attributionString: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International
license.aiProcessingPermitted: not restricted by the licence text
license.meshVariants: 95% and 99% polygon reduction rates, distributed as ZIP archives
license.notes: The current DBCLS license page was updated 2025-02-27 and now states CC BY 4.0 International, resolving the earlier disagreement with Z-Anatomy's attribution. The acquired FJ1446 OBJ still embeds the archive's historical CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan notice, so the sample preserves that notice and is conservatively handled under both sets of terms.
license.historicalNotice: The extracted FJ1446 OBJ header states CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan. It is preserved verbatim even though the current licensor page states CC BY 4.0 International.

scoreRationale.license_clarity: 4, not 5: the current terms and attribution are explicit and commercially flexible, but the acquired OBJ retains an older CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan header. Conservatively preserving both notices avoids an unsupported relicensing assumption.

coverageObservation.method: scripts/assets/coverage.mjs evaluates an explicit 28-target master plan 4.3 list across all eight published text metadata files (60,317 lines). Simple targets use recorded case-insensitive terms; compound groups require every named component group. Labels only; meshes not inspected.
coverageObservation.namingGranularity: largely group/compartment level rather than individual muscles
coverageObservation.caveat: This is an observation, NOT a section 8.3 coverage_naming score. SBLA-005 owns scoring and must confirm by inspecting meshes.
coverageObservation.corroboration: The erector-spinae grouping is present through its iliocostalis, longissimus, and spinalis components and mesh mappings. Neighbouring back muscles are present - pectoralis major 72, deltoid 69, trapezius 44, rhomboid 42, teres major 13 - so zero hits for latissimus is a gap, not a naming mismatch.

candidates.name: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology 2e

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0
license.attributionString: Copyright Rice University, OpenStax, under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.
license.aiProcessingPermitted: PROHIBITED for LLM training or ingestion without permission
license.notes: NonCommercial, and it explicitly prohibits LLM ingestion without permission. Master plan 8.1 lists "No prohibition on AI-assisted processing" as a required asset capability, and this project is executed by AI agents, so the restriction is directly disqualifying for any ingestion-based use. It may still be read by a human as a reference. Commercial entities must contact OpenStax separately.
license.aiRestrictionQuote: This book may not be used in the training of large language models or otherwise be ingested into large language models or generative AI offerings without OpenStax’s permission.

scoreRationale.license_clarity: 5: terms, attribution string, and the commercial restriction are stated unambiguously at the primary source. Clear terms are not the same as suitable terms - the NC restriction is a suitability problem, recorded in notes, not a clarity problem.

candidates.ineligibleReason: NonCommercial under 8.1, and prohibits LLM ingestion without permission, which this AI-executed project cannot satisfy for ingestion-based use.

exerciseMedia.strategy: Derive from the selected anatomy asset per master plan §11.9: scripted staged stills, joint-path diagrams, and short rigged 3D loops.
exerciseMedia.constraint: Whatever licence the anatomy asset carries must explicitly permit rigging, rendering, and web distribution of derived media. Generated photoreal human video is excluded by §11.9.
exerciseMedia.prohibited: Do not use generative image models to fabricate anatomical structures presented as accurate anatomy (§8.4).
